marc:datafield.marc:subfield: 1. Old Items -. Upin and Ipin helped Tok Dalang to clear the store. While packing jar contain coins and old banknotes, Tok Dalang recounts the history of the coin and the paper money which is antiques. One day, Tok Dalang had lost his old banknotes. Is the lost money can be found?2. Haze Hazard. Following the severe haze that struck, Tadika Mesra was closed and all activities were limited. Upin, Ipin and friends also cannot go out. As the haze strikes, various things have been witnessed by Upin and Ipin, resulting in the awareness of the importance of maintaining the environment.
